methods.doc: Sets the HardwareActionMatcher that is used to recognize when this action happens.

SpecificDevice.doc: Interface that can be used to directly access a specific device (Bitwig native device or plug-in).

Preferences.doc: This interface is used to store custom controller settings into the Bitwig Studio preferences.

ClipBrowsingSession.doc: Instances of this interface are used for browsing clips, including access to all filter columns and the result column as shown in the 'Clips' tab of Bitwig Studio's contextual browser window.
